1.explanation: This Jest test uses the existing CategoryRenderer and a real sampleResults fixture. We locate the “accessibility” category, mutate all its passed audits so they have a warnings array, then invoke renderer.render(). Once the code under test is updated to implement the bug fix, this test will find a new '.lh-warnings' block immediately after the '.lh-clump--passed' section, containing the heading “Warnings:” and the nested bullet-point details, just like in the screenshot.
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse HTML report, when one or more audits have passed but still emitted warnings, those warnings aren’t surfaced in the "Passed audits" section. The expected UI (shown in the screenshot) is that immediately after the expanded “Passed audits” list there’s a styled box labeled “Warnings:” with a nested bullet list of all the warning messages from the passed audits.
